note: Strategies for the intraday F&O explorer (python run_trader.py fno explore ...). EXPLORATION, NOT EVIDENCE: paper fills at the touch, net of every cost; a strategy that passes the screen earns a registered forward test, not a claim. Each strategy names a template in trading/fno/library.py and may override any field. To change it, copy this file to config/fno_strategies.json (gitignored, read first; editing a tracked file would stop V's runner). Changing the configuration starts a new generation and restarts the screen.
